memory_estimate_scope: Rough duplication of the observed footprint; no second allocator or task was run.

io_evidence.scope: Whole backing device, includes other users and processes; not training-only I/O.

interpretation: This sample supports retaining existing concurrency: CPU has headroom, but the shared dataset device is continuously busy with queued reads. A second same-batch HA task exceeds physical memory; H leaves under1GiB by a rough footprint estimate. More training risks I/O contention and OOM.
